name: plamo-ja
description: Claude replies in English and the transcript shows a Japanese translation from a local PLaMo 3 Translate server

endpoint.title: Endpoint
endpoint.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL of the llama-server running PLaMo 3 Translate

model.title: Model
model.description: Model name sent in the request (llama-server --alias)

form.title: Japanese style
form.description: polite for desu/masu, plain for da/de-aru

size.title: Model size
size.description: PLaMo 3 Translate size used until /plamo model picks another

ggufDir.title: GGUF folder
ggufDir.description: Folder holding plamo-3-translate-<size>-Q4_K_M.gguf; a missing file is downloaded from Hugging Face with llama-server -hf

context.title: Translation context
context.description: Background passed to PLaMo as PFML3 context; empty disables it
context.default: A status report from an AI coding agent to a software engineer. Terse technical writing, like a commit message or code review comment.
